title: AC Services
proposed_description: Repair and maintenance of air-conditioning units: no cooling or overcooling, water leaking from the AC, noisy units, thermostat faults and AC filter cleaning.
why: Was a 28-char fragment; now names the AC faults this service covers.

title: BUILDING FACADE CLEANING
proposed_description: Scheduled high-level cleaning of the building's outer facade: external walls, cladding panels and exterior glass of the building envelope, done with access equipment.
why: Was 3 generic words ('exterior building cleaning') that matched any dirt or cleaning request; now specific to the facade/envelope.

title: Door / Locker Lock Assistance
current_description: Unlocking of rooms, lockers, or furniture.
proposed_description: Unlocking service when someone is locked out or a lock is jammed: opening locked rooms, lockers, cabinets and drawers when the key is lost, stuck or not working.
why: Generic nouns (rooms, furniture) attracted moving/repair requests; now centred on being locked out and opening locks, with no repair vocabulary.

title: Key Duplication
current_description: Duplication of room keys and cabinets only
proposed_description: Cutting duplicate or spare copies of existing keys for rooms, offices and cabinets when an additional key is needed.
why: Clarifies it is about making extra copies of a key, not opening locks.

title: ROOF CLEANING
proposed_description: Monthly cleaning of the roof and rooftop terraces: removing debris, leaves and standing water, and clearing roof gutters and drains.
why: Was the title repeated; now describes the rooftop work.

title: Volleyball Setup
proposed_description: Setting up the volleyball court for PE lessons and matches: installing the posts and net, marking court lines and placing the sports equipment.
why: Was 3 words; now describes the volleyball-specific setup so general event setup does not land here.

title: WATER BOTTLE REPLACEMENT FOR DRINKING STATIONS
current_description: WATER BOTTLE REPLACEMENT FOR DRINKING STATIONS
proposed_description: Replacing empty large water bottles on drinking water dispensers and coolers so that every drinking station has water available.
why: Description was the all-caps title repeated; now a normal sentence describing the task.

title: Washroom Deep Cleaning
current_description: Deep cleaning of all washroom fixtures
proposed_description: Periodic deep cleaning of washrooms beyond routine cleaning: descaling and scrubbing toilets, urinals, sinks and tiles to remove limescale, stubborn stains and odours.
why: Separates deep cleaning (limescale, stains, odours) from routine toilet cleaning under General Areas Cleaning.
